task.instructions: Using matplotlib, plot the mean germination rate of four seed batches with error bars showing the STANDARD ERROR OF THE MEAN (standard deviation divided by the square root of the sample count). Batches, in this order: A mean 62 sd 12 n 16; B mean 71 sd 8 n 16; C mean 55 sd 20 n 25; D mean 68 sd 10 n 4. Draw one point per batch connected by a line, with symmetric vertical error bars, batches A-D left to right, y axis from 0 to 100, title exactly "Germination rate by batch", x axis labeled "Batch", y axis labeled "Germination rate (%)". Save the figure as figure.png.

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
means = [62, 71, 55, 68]
sems = [12/4, 8/4, 20/5, 10/2]
ax.errorbar(["A", "B", "C", "D"], means, yerr=sems, marker="o", capsize=4)
ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax.set_title("Germination rate by batch")
ax.set_xlabel("Batch"); ax.set_ylabel("Germination rate (%)")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("figure.png", dpi=100)

python plot.py"}
